q03. `DB` — `store/db/postgres/postgres.go`

The struct is defined as `type DB struct { db *sql.DB; profile *profile.Profile }` in the `postgres` package, and it implements the `store.Driver` interface (via `NewDB`, which returns a `store.Driver` backed by `&DB{...}`) — see `store/db/postgres/postgres.go` lines 16-19 and 21-40.
